name: PCI DSS v4.0
description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard v4.0.1 — 12 requirements for cardholder data environments (CDE). Applies to all entities storing/processing/transmitting cardholder data.

categories.name: Build and maintain a secure network (Req 1–2)

controls.name: Network security controls
controls.req: Install and maintain network security controls (firewalls, segmentation of CDE, deny-by-default egress/ingress).

controls.name: NSC configuration
controls.req: Secure configuration of network security controls: deny by default, limited DMZ services, documented rules.

controls.name: Secure configuration of systems
controls.req: Apply vendor hardening (remove defaults — passwords, SNMP strings, services), manage configuration of all system components.

controls.name: Protect stored account data
controls.req: Minimize storage; never store PAN beyond need; render PAN unreadable (encryption/truncation); protect SAD (CVV, PIN, track).

controls.name: PAN display protection
controls.req: Mask PAN displays (max 4–6 digits) per role; restrict ability to copy/move PAN.

controls.name: Protect cardholder data in transit
controls.req: Use strong cryptography for transmission (TLS 1.2+, no SSL/early TLS); never send unprotected PAN over open networks.

categories.name: Maintain a vulnerability management program (Req 5–6) and monitor (Req 10–11)

controls.name: Protect against malware
controls.req: Deploy and maintain anti-malware (AV/EDR) on all system components; keep updated; address non-OS mobile/browser risks.

controls.name: Secure software development
controls.req: Vulnerability mgmt for custom/acquired software: secure coding (OWASP), SAST/DAST for web apps, patch critical/high CVEs within timelines.

controls.name: Logging and monitoring
controls.req: Log all access to system components + CDE (audit trail: who, when, what); monitor logs and audit trails for anomalies.

controls.name: Log integrity
controls.req: Protect audit logs from modification; review daily; retain 12 months history with 3 months immediately available.

controls.name: Test security of systems
controls.req: Quarterly internal + external vulnerability scans (ASV for external), annual penetration testing incl. segmentation effectiveness.

controls.name: Restrict access by need-to-know
controls.req: Limit access to system components and CDE to least privilege; role-based access; documented approvals.

controls.name: Identify and authenticate users
controls.req: Unique IDs, strong authentication (MFA for remote/CDE admin), lockout policies, session management; no shared accounts.

controls.name: Restrict physical access
controls.req: Physical access controls to CDE (facility access, media storage, badge logs, video monitoring, POI device tamper checks).

controls.name: Information security policy
controls.req: Supporting policies and operational procedures: risk assessments, incident response plan, vendor/supplier management, periodic reviews.

license: Public standard — simplified checklist (use official SAQ/ROC for compliance)
